field.label: Magic Editor X
field.description: Block editor with media, embeds, custom blocks, history and live collaboration
field.options.placeholder.label: Placeholder
field.options.placeholder.description: Text shown while the editor is empty
field.options.minHeight.label: Minimum height (px)
field.options.minHeight.description: Height of the empty editor, between 120 and 2000 pixels
field.options.preset.label: Preset
field.options.preset.description: Which blocks, formatting and tools editors can use in this field. Enforced when saving. Start with Simple and switch to Standard when you need more.
field.options.linkTargets.label: Allowed links
field.options.linkTargets.description: Links to entries of this site, to web addresses, both or none
field.options.requireAlt.label: Require alternative text for images
field.options.requireAlt.description: Images need a text description or must be marked as decorative
field.options.allowedBlocks.label: Allowed blocks
field.options.allowedBlocks.description: Comma-separated block names that replace the preset list, for example: paragraph, header, list, image, myCustomBlock
field.options.headingLevels.label: Heading levels
field.options.headingLevels.description: For example 2-4 or 2,3. Empty uses the preset.
field.options.maxBlocks.label: Maximum number of blocks
field.options.maxCharacters.label: Maximum number of characters
field.options.maxCharacters.description: Visible text, counted like the editor toolbar. Empty or 0 means no limit.
field.options.disableAi.label: Turn off the AI assistant for this field
field.options.disableGrammar.label: Turn off the grammar check for this field
field.options.disableGrammar.description: No text from this field is sent to LanguageTool
field.options.disableCollaboration.label: Turn off live collaboration for this field
field.options.publishGuard.label: Block publishing while quality checks report errors
field.options.publishGuard.description: Errors are missing alternative texts (when required) and empty links, plus readability and SEO hints your administrator chose to block publishing
field.options.disableContentChecks.label: Turn off readability and SEO hints for this field
field.options.disableContentChecks.descr: For short fields such as a teaser, where word counts and subheadings do not apply
field.options.preset.article: Article: long-form text without raw HTML
field.options.preset.minimal: Minimal: paragraphs, lists, bold, italic, links
field.options.inlineColors.label: Text colour and highlight
field.options.inlineColors.description: Editors pick from the colours your developer set in the plugin configuration (palette). Without a palette nothing is shown.
field.options.inlineScript.label: Superscript and subscript
field.options.inlineScript.description: For formulas and units such as m² or H₂O
field.options.inlineAnnotations.label: Annotations
field.options.inlineAnnotations.descript: Comma-separated annotation names, for example: abbreviation. Your developer can add more, such as glossary.
field.options.allowedComponents.label: Components editors can insert
field.options.allowedComponents.descript: Each one appears in the + menu of this field under its name. Checked again when saving.
field.options.allowedComponents.loadErro: The components could not be loaded.
field.options.allowedComponents.empty: This app has no components yet. Create one in the Content-Type Builder first.
field.options.allowedComponents.unsuppor: Cannot be used as blocks (only text, number, date, choice and on/off fields are supported):
field.options.aiActions.label: AI actions in this field
field.options.aiActions.description: Comma-separated action keys, for example: improve, shorten, ask, proofread, clarity, style-guide or the key of your own action. Empty offers every action. Checked again on the server.
field.options.preset.simple: Simple: like Strapi Blocks, plus tables (recommended)
field.options.preset.standard: Standard: every block and tool except raw HTML
